en.title: cl
en.summary: This is the letter L335 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: Sounds of cl
paragraphs: The letters cl make two sounds together. You hear this sound sequence in (clap) /klæp/, which means to hit your hands together. These letters have one regular sound pattern.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Release the air suddenly with no voice. Quickly place the tip of your tongue on the ridge behind your upper teeth. Let the air flow smoothly around the sides of your tongue with your voice on. Touch your throat to feel the voice start as your tongue moves forward.

sections.title: Spelling patterns
paragraphs: In all positions, these letters make the sound heard in (club) /klʌb/. They join a voiceless stop with a voiced flow of air.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not insert a short vowel between the two consonants. Move your tongue directly from the back of your mouth to the ridge behind your teeth without pausing.
